description: Gold expectations for the Stage 00B baseline carrier derived from the edgar_full_index fixture frame (window 2022-08-01..2023-02-28) at the W0-frozen baseline cutoff 2022-11-29 (configs/project.yaml, ADR-077). Five domestic firms: LEDGERWORKS (two annual filings straddling the cutoff; baseline is the 2022-09-15 10-K, not the 2023-01-25 one) and TRANSIT DATA COOP are baseline candidates; the three combined-filing firms (one shared accession, one carrier row each, ADR-080) filed only after the cutoff and are retained post-baseline entrants. Three FPI-extension firms, all baseline candidates, including both filers of the combined 40-F. No ties, no dual-stratum CIKs, no exclusions.
